user.title: Connect PawWeather
user.description: Open the PawWeather app on your phone, go to Settings → Home Assistant and tap “Create code”. Enter the six characters here. The code is valid for ten minutes.

data_description.code: Six characters from the app, e.g. ABC-DEF.

reauth_confirm.title: Connect PawWeather again
reauth_confirm.description: The connection was removed in the app or replaced by a new one. Create a new code in the app under Settings → Home Assistant and enter it here.

data_description.code: Six characters from the app, e.g. ABC-DEF.

error.code_ungueltig: This code is unknown, expired or has already been used. Create a new one in the app.
error.gebremst: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
error.nicht_erreichbar: The PawWeather server could not be reached.

abort.already_configured: This phone is already connected. The connection has been renewed.
abort.anderes_telefon: This code comes from a different phone than the original connection. Remove the integration and add it again to switch phones.

init.title: Location
init.description: Weather, walk light and warnings are fetched for this zone. Its coordinates are sent to the PawWeather server and are not stored there.

kopplung_ungueltig.message: The connection to the app is no longer valid. Please enter a new code.

gebremst.message: The PawWeather server asks to wait before the next request.

nicht_erreichbar.message: The PawWeather server could not be reached: {fehler}
